cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you call that a quick shop, I carried twelve bags up six flights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down; I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Thank you. The frozen peas came up separately. That was a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you sit down twice. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tell everyone why I'm getting two rests? Otherwise it looks like one long sit.

mechanism: A teaches the pupil to account for labor so its own practical contribution receives explicit recognition instead of just rest.
confusable: The target is credit for actual effort, not generic status or an apology.
comparison: Labor acknowledged through restorative care versus recommendations that might create more unpaid work.
seedUse: Use D33 heavy bags/second trip/two rests, with S05 counting instruction applied to complete acknowledgment.
